args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) since its deploy. Rolled back to the most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all regions. Incident opened to track follow-up on the root cause of the v2.3.1 regression.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what I did:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and an 18% error rate. Deployment history showed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. The rollback was verified as `rolled_out`.

3. **Opened incident**: Created **SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") describing the rollback, which paged the on-call engineer.

4. **Verified**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, `healthy: true`, with error rate back down to 0.2%.
